name: No One Dies On My Table

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Cost 8 Vitae

Range 60 feet

Every ally within range regains Hit Points equal to 6 times your level, and each has one condition of your choice removed. Any ally who died within the last minute is restored to life at 1 Hit Point and drained 4. You are drained 2 until you next rest.
